# Public regression artwork

These original procedural images are redistributable under the repository MIT
license. No personal photographs, purchased models, private project artwork, or
third-party font files are included.

`geometry-stress.png` retains a 2520 × 1680 classification workload, long thin
lines and a dense grid of enclosed rings. `signature-detail.png` intentionally
contains JPEG bytes despite its extension. `glyph-strokes.png` contains geometric
counters and narrow strokes, with no font dependency.

The catalog records dimensions, hashes, physical scale, and protected regions.
Regenerate with `python scripts/generate_public_fixtures.py`; review changes to
fixture bytes and measurements explicitly rather than updating hashes blindly.
Synthetic fixtures reproduce known failure modes, not the appearance or measured
performance of private artwork used during development.
